attestations.text: CH'ÊN Chao-lun 陳兆崙 (T. 星齋, H. 句山, original ming 兆嶸), Jan. 14, 1701–1771, Mar. 12, man of letters and calligrapher, was a native of Ch'ien-t'ang, Chekiang. While still a young man he obtained recognition for his literary and calligraphic ability, and such eminent contemporaries of Chekiang province as Hang Shih-chün and Liang Shih-chêng [qq. v.] were his friends.
